# v0.6.0 — Explanations and dependency-first adapters

## Highlights

- **EL engine:** in-house ELK-style completion in `ontologos-el` (not whelk)
- **`ontologos-bridge`**: core ↔ horned-owl/oxrdf/reasonable adapters
- **RL/RDFS → reasonable**: custom in-tree rule engines removed; public facade APIs unchanged
- **CI gates**: Pizza EL golden vs in-house EL; Family RL triple closure vs reasonable

## Published crates

- **crates.io:** all library crates at **0.6.0** (`ontologos-core` through `ontologos-explain`)
- **PyPI:** `ontologos` **0.6.0** (includes full workspace via maturin)

## Upgrade notes

See [docs/migration/v0.5.x-to-v0.6.0.md](../../docs/migration/v0.5.x-to-v0.6.0.md).

Key changes:

- `MaterializationReport.traces` → `.trace`
- `inferred_by_rule` counts are empty under the reasonable adapter until upstream adds rule diagnostics
- EL `classify()` returns a `Taxonomy`; RL/RDFS `materialize()` / `saturate()` merge into the ontology
